# Cinderlift -- everything here is meant to be found.
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# The compiled game is 1.5 MB of WebAssembly with nothing readable in it.
# Crawlers that fetch it gain no index-able text and cost bandwidth, so they
# are pointed away from it rather than left to download it on every visit.
Disallow: /cinderlift.wasm
Disallow: /cinderlift.js

Sitemap: https://cinderlift.com/sitemap.xml
# The wiki keeps its own, generated by tools/wiki.cpp from the pages it wrote.
# Several hundred URLs is not a list anyone maintains correctly by hand.
Sitemap: https://cinderlift.com/wiki/sitemap.xml
